title: xdrip plus 14 day libre calibration issues
symptom: Calibrations with weeks settling for 50 or more points of deviation. After calibrating, the next 5 minutes when the sensor reports data the raw data is accepted and I get two arrows down, then adjusted to the raw values from libre. Using tomato app the calibration takes and gives pretty good values when not using xdrip.
